sets.title: Practice Set 01
sets.blurb: 25 original passages on the themes CLAT PG keeps returning to: Section 6A, Article 370, Supriyo, the new criminal codes, Article 299, arbitration and more. Moderate to extreme, every trap explained.

sets.title: Practice Set 02
sets.blurb: The Constitution through its amendments, recent to past: the 106th Amendment, Governors and Presidential assent, GST, Basic Structure, Tenth Schedule, Article 356, plus BNS, BNSS, Specific Relief, consumer, family and land law. Moderate to tough, every trap explained.
